gen-gf-unkempt-fs-literata: Unkempt draws its strokes like rod stock, crossbar and stem on the t exactly matched, and it carries real swagger. Literata, a text serif, brings a soft thick-to-thin shift beneath it that keeps everything from turning stark.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-sentient: Sentient sits below with pinched, closed-in apertures and faint nib pressure. Over it, Unkempt keeps a uniform stroke throughout, so the round, pressured letters and the rod-straight ones lend each other their strongest points.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-bespoke-slab: Stenciled and loud, Wallpoet cuts a line through each letter where the paper shows, and its lowercase climbs high. Bespoke Slab follows with tall-bodied lowercase and a grounded, refined manner, so paragraphs would settle in steadily.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-erode: Erode has a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and a gentle ebb and flow in its stroke weight, which feels dignified and editorial. But Wallpoet's low-contrast, stencil-cut heading sets the tone first, so a long stretch of text would flow smoothly beneath it.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-hoover: Wallpoet's stencil gap, where the paper shows between letters, is its signature, and its lowercase rises high. Hoover answers with a generous opening into the e and compressed ascenders, a robust classic serif that keeps the page grounded.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-trench-slab: Wallpoet's stencil breaks let paper show between its letters. Trench Slab, a text serif, leaves little gap between x-height and caps, so a long passage would read dense, dignified and refined.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-domine: Stenciled, tall and brash: that's Wallpoet. Domine, a classic serif with compact ascenders and breathing room inside each curve, settles in below with a moderate stem-to-hairline ratio that tames the loud heading.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-esteban: Wallpoet's stencil cut, with paper showing between letters, is the first thing you notice. It shouts best at large sizes, while Esteban's sturdy hairlines and wide-open e do the quieter, steadier work of carrying text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-faustina: Loud, stenciled and tall in the lowercase, Wallpoet takes the top spot. Faustina, a serif with moderate swelling and an open-jawed c, gives it an authoritative partner.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-halant: Halant brings a faint thick-thin shift, outward-pointing terminals and a towering x-height. Under Wallpoet's low-contrast stencil heading, a long passage would feel traditional, authoritative and unhurried.
